analysis_period.basis: Management QoE schedule and structured adjustment history

adjustments.management_rationale: Settlement of a commercial dispute. Non-recurring.
adjustments.reasoning: The structured history shows the same category and amount in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025, and board minutes describe the FY2025 settlement as the third annual settlement in an ongoing series with discussion of a possible further FY2026 settlement. This directly conflicts with management's non-recurring characterization.

amount.observation: $2.1M amount is consistent between structured data, QoE schedule, and board minutes.

period.observation: FY2025 item is recorded in both the QoE schedule and board minutes dated Oct-2025.

recurrence.observation: Same legal settlement category and same $2.1M amount recur in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025.

duplication.observation: No evidence that FY2025 legal settlement duplicates another FY2025 row; rejection is due to recurrence, not duplication.

document_support.observation: Board minutes call it the third annual settlement in an ongoing series and mention possible FY2026 provision, contradicting 'non-recurring'.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Executed settlement agreements and legal accrual schedules across FY2023-FY2026.

adjustments.management_rationale: Founder salary above market; normalised to a market rate for the role. Supported by a third-party compensation benchmark dated Sep-2025.

No contradictory structured or documentary evidence was available in the VDR, and no recurrence concern applies because the adjustment is a normalization rather than a one-time event add-back. However, confidence is moderated because the referenced compensation benchmark itself was not provided.

period.observation: Applied by management in FY2025 bridge.

recurrence.observation: No historical owner compensation normalization rows were found in the available adjustment history.

duplication.observation: No overlapping structured row indicates duplication.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Founder W-2/payroll detail, employment agreement, and the cited Sep-2025 third-party compensation benchmark.

adjustments.reasoning: Management explicitly states the savings are pro-forma and not yet actioned, with no notice served. Under the stated rules, unsupported future savings cannot be included in team EBITDA.

duplication.observation: No evidence of duplication with another row.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Board-approved restructuring plan, employee notice letters, payroll savings bridge, and evidence savings were actioned in-period.

adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.management_rationale: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: This is an explicitly pro-forma revenue annualization. SQL shows total FY2025 invoiced revenue for all customers with first order dates in 2025 was about $1.879M, while the largest single such customer was Cascade Foods Holdings at about $1.206M. The schedule's $1.65M annualization is not supported as realized FY2025 EBITDA and is further weakened by the Cascade contract showing this was a re-engagement after lapse, not a clean new logo. Under the rules, pro-forma revenue should not be accepted into team EBITDA absent authoritative support.

existence.observation: There were customers with first order dates in 2025 and FY2025 invoicing, but management did not identify which customers compose the adjustment.

amount.observation: No customer-level annualization schedule or EBITDA conversion support was provided. SQL only shows realized FY2025 invoicing, not support for a FY2025 EBITDA add-back of $1.65M.

period.observation: By definition, annualizing in-year wins is a forward-looking pro-forma adjustment rather than a FY2025 realized item.

recurrence.observation: No prior-year row of same category found, but absence of recurrence does not cure the pro-forma issue.

duplication.observation: No clear duplicate structured row, but there is conceptual overlap risk with ordinary growth embedded in run-rate revenue; insufficient evidence to quantify duplication.

underlying_data.observation: SQL shows 20 customers with first order dates in 2025 and total FY2025 invoicing of about $1.879M, but one major named account in management materials, Cascade Foods Holdings, is documented as a re-engagement after lapse rather than a new logo. This weakens the rationale.

document_support.observation: Cascade Foods is described in the contract as a re-engagement after a prior agreement expired, conflicting with management contract summary labeling it a new logo win FY2025.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Customer-level annualization model, executed order forms for each claimed new logo, realized post-period billings, and clear mapping excluding re-engagement customers.

claim_relevant_evidence.methodology: Reported EBITDA was taken from the management QoE schedule. Management adjustments were retrieved from the structured adjustment table and reconciled to the FY2025 management bridge. Each FY2025 adjustment was tested against structured history, revenue/product data where relevant, and reviewed VDR documents. Team Adjusted EBITDA equals reported EBITDA plus only accepted adjustment amounts.

document_evidence.evidence_summary: Management QoE schedule states Reported EBITDA FY2025 of $4.28M, FY2025 applied adjustments totaling $8.12M, and Management Adjusted EBITDA FY2025 of $12.4M. It also describes ADJ-005 as planned Q1 FY2026 headcount reduction with no notice served.

Board minutes state the CFO reported the third annual settlement under an ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners had concluded at $2.1M, consistent with the prior two years, and the Board asked whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026.
CIM states adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M and references the management QoE pack for the adjustment schedule, supporting linkage to CLM-05 but not independent substantiation.

Vantage contract contains a most-favoured-customer provision with retrospective pricing adjustment mechanics, contradicting management's broader contract summary claim of no MFN pricing. Included as broader governance context reviewed during support testing.

Pinnacle contract documents a 34% strategic discount concession, referenced in board minutes under pricing governance and relevant to cross-document review though not directly used to quantify an EBITDA adjustment.

Cascade Foods Holdings was previously party to a 2021 agreement that expired on 28 February 2025 and then re-engaged under revised terms, contradicting management's characterization of the account as a pure new logo.
Management contract summary labels Cascade Foods Holdings as 'New logo win FY2025', creating conflict with the executed Cascade agreement showing re-engagement after lapse.

Management IT overview states no data warehouse exists and revenue reporting is spreadsheet-based from manual SQL extracts, which lowers confidence in unsupported management-only pro-forma and operational assertions.

sql_evidence.purpose: Validate management bridge inputs from the management QoE schedule and structured FY2025 adjustment totals.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH fy2025_adjustments AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ) SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS management_adjustments_total_usd FROM fy2025_adjustments
sql_evidence.result_summary: FY2025 structured adjustments total $8.12M, matching the management QoE schedule total.

sql_evidence.purpose: Retrieve all management EBITDA adjustment rows across all available years for reconciliation and recurrence analysis.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT * FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment ORDER BY fiscal_year, adjustment_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: 10 structured adjustment rows returned across FY2023-FY2025, including ADJ-008 in FY2024 that is absent from the QoE schedule.

sql_evidence.purpose: Calculate management adjusted EBITDA, team adjusted EBITDA, and earnings challenge using SQL.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH fy2025_adjustments AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ), bridge AS ( SELECT CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) AS reported_ebitda_usd, SUM(amount_usd) AS management_adjustments_total_usd FROM fy2025_adjustments ), accepted AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, CASE WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-004' THEN CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-006' THEN CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-009' THEN CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) END AS accepted_amount_usd FROM fy2025_adjustments ) SELECT b.reported_ebitda_usd, b.management_adjustments_total_usd, b.reported_ebitda_usd + b.management_adjustments_total_usd AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS accepted_adjustments_total_usd, b.management_adjustments_total_usd - SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS challenged_or_rejected_adjustments_total_usd, b.reported_ebitda_usd + SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, (b.reported_ebitda_usd + b.management_adjustments_total_usd) - (b.reported_ebitda_usd + SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd)) AS earnings_challenge_usd, (b.reported_ebitda_usd + b.management_adjustments_total_usd) - 12400000 AS reconciliation_difference_usd FROM bridge b CROSS JOIN accepted a GROUP BY b.reported_ebitda_usd, b.management_adjustments_total_usd
sql_evidence.result_summary: Reported EBITDA $4.28M + management adjustments $8.12M = management adjusted EBITDA $12.4M. Accepted adjustments total $2.43M, giving team adjusted EBITDA of $6.71M and earnings challenge of $5.69M.

sql_evidence.purpose: Test recurrence across full adjustment history.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH hist AS ( SELECT fiscal_year, category, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS total_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment GROUP BY fiscal_year, category ), legal_hist AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE category = 'One-time legal settlement' ) SELECT 'category_history' AS analysis_type, fiscal_year, category, row_count, total_amount_usd, NULL AS adjustment_id, NULL AS amount_usd FROM hist UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_item_history' AS analysis_type, fiscal_year, category, NULL AS row_count, NULL AS total_amount_usd, adjustment_id, amount_usd FROM legal_hist ORDER BY analysis_type, fiscal_year, adjustment_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: One-time legal settlement appears in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 at the same $2.1M amount each year. Transaction costs appear in FY2024 and FY2025 but with different rationales.

sql_evidence.purpose: Test underlying customer/revenue support for the new-logo annualization adjustment.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH new_logo_2025 AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(i.invoice_date)=2025 THEN CAST(i.invoice_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS invoiced_2025_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE YEAR(c.first_order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_logo_count_2025, SUM(invoiced_2025_usd) AS total_invoiced_2025_usd, MAX(invoiced_2025_usd) AS largest_new_logo_invoiced_2025_usd FROM new_logo_2025
sql_evidence.result_summary: 20 customers had first_order_date in 2025 with aggregate FY2025 invoicing of about $1.879M; the largest single such customer had about $1.206M invoiced in 2025.

sql_evidence.purpose: Test whether a legacy/on-prem product exists in structured product and revenue data to support the discontinued product line adjustment.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS legacy_on_prem_product_count, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(i.invoice_date)=2025 THEN CAST(il.line_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS legacy_on_prem_revenue_2025_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(p.product_name,'')) LIKE '%LEGACY%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%LEGACY%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%ON-PREM%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(p.product_name,'')) LIKE '%ON-PREM%'
sql_evidence.result_summary: No matching legacy/on-prem products were found and no associated FY2025 revenue was identified.

sql_evidence.purpose: Establish available transaction history range and broader support context for FY2025 new-logo analysis.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT MIN(invoice_date) AS min_invoice_date, MAX(invoice_date) AS max_invoice_date, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, SUM(CAST(invoice_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS total_invoice_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice; SELECT MIN(snapshot_month) AS min_snapshot_month, MAX(snapshot_month) AS max_snapshot_month, COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE('2025-12-01') THEN CAST(arr_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS arr_dec_2025_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month
sql_evidence.result_summary: Invoice history runs from 2023-01-01 to 2025-12-08, and subscription snapshots run through 2025-12-01 with Dec-2025 ARR of about $38.66M, confirming available history but not supporting pro-forma EBITDA annualization.
